name: Cheese English Muffins
description: Toasted English muffin quarters topped with a rich cheese and bacon mixture.
recipeIngredient: ½ lb sharp yellow cheese, grated

recipeInstructions.text: Mix grated cheese, mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, crumbled bacon, and chopped onion together.
Slice English muffins into quarters.
Spread the cheese mixture onto the English muffin quarters.
Bake at 400°F for 10 minutes.

_similar.name: Cheese Dip in a Bread Bowl
_similar.description: A warm cheese and ham dip served in a hollowed-out bread loaf.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the bread loaf and hollow out most of the soft bread inside.
Mix together the cream cheese, sour cream, ham, green pepper, green onion, cheddar cheese, Tabasco sauce, and Worcestershire sauce.
Fill the hollowed bread loaf with the cheese mixture and replace the lid.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot with the reserved bread chunks and fresh veggies for dipping.

_similar.keywords: bread bowl dip, ham and cheese dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Cheese Ball
_similar.description: A classic cheese ball made with grated cheese, Cheez Whiz, and deviled ham, perfect for a quick appetizer.
recipeIngredient: Chopped pecans or parsley flakes for coating

recipeInstructions.text: Beat all ingredients in a mixer until creamed.
Form into 2 balls and wrap in Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate until firm.
Roll into chopped pecans or parsley flakes to coat.

_similar.keywords: cheese ball, party appetizer, easy snack

_similar.name: English Shepherd's Pie
_similar.description: A traditional shepherd's pie with ground beef, vegetables, and mashed potatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef briskly over high heat. Drain off excess fat.
Add the chopped onion and reduce heat. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until the meat is well browned.
Sprinkle the flour over the meat mixture and stir to coat evenly.
Gradually add water, stock cube, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, bay leaf, and thyme. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes until the gravy thickens.
Add the can of peas to the meat mixture.
Transfer the meat mixture to a casserole dish and cover with mashed potatoes.
Bake in a 400°F oven until the top is golden brown.

_similar.keywords: shepherd's pie, ground beef, mashed potatoes

_similar.name: Fruit Dip
_similar.description: A simple and flavorful cream cheese dip infused with orange juice and marshmallow creme, ideal for fresh fruit.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients in a dish and beat until smooth and well blended.
Serve immediately with fresh cut-up fruit.

_similar.keywords: fruit dip, orange cream cheese, marshmallow dip

_similar.name: Crunchy Top Ham and Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty ham and potato casserole with a crunchy corn flake topping.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 (10 oz) can cream of chicken soup, undiluted

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all casserole ingredients and mix well.
Place the mixture in a 13x9 inch baking dish.
Combine topping ingredients (melted butter and crushed corn flakes) and sprinkle on top of the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.keywords: ham and potato casserole, crunchy topping, comforting casserole
